empirical_aperture_basis.pressure_calibration: wall pressure tapered to zero over the final 12.5 km at each crack tip, then scaled in the elastic mesh to match 4 m mean opening; peak opening is an independent check
empirical_aperture_basis.reference: Grandin et al. (2009), 2005 Manda Hararo-Dabbahu dike inversion

limits: The pressure is held constant during the diagnostic interval; the model does not resolve episode duration, magma transport, or post-intrusion solidification.
The pressure comparison conditions on an existing disconnected crack; it does not test crack nucleation, and the zero-pressure crack is an artificial control rather than an intact host.
The observed Afar dike constrains this diagnostic aperture scale only, not global dike pressure, event cadence, fracture toughness, or plume attribution.
A positive result is a local-mechanics screen, not calibration or validation of geological rift propagation.
matched_boundary_conditions: all cases fix left/right horizontal displacement and bottom-left/bottom-right vertical displacement

mesh_and_material.mesh: 32 x 20 structured P1 triangles with duplicated internal dike-face nodes

pressure_on_off_control: each pressure pair shares the same disconnected crack-face mesh, displacement supports, tectonic loading, and initial damage; only the pressure force changes
